name: RMS
description: Manages return and exchange processes for orders coming from integrated e-commerce stores (Shopify, Custom). Split across two repositories: the app hosts the backend and the seller Return Panel, the portal hosts the buyer-facing Return Portal.

repos.name: app
repos.description: NestJS backend and Next.js seller Return Panel. Owns the return lifecycle, return policy, cargo and shipping, Shopify store connection, wallet, analytics and the WMS integration.
